body:
`tests/unit/test_802_metadata_change_dispatch.py::test_enforcer_missing_log_logs_single_info_not_warning_spam`
fails on `origin/main`.

Found while checking the blast radius of #1521 (auto-merge base gate). A/B'd
deliberately rather than assumed: the test was run on the PR branch (red), then
on a clean `origin/main` checkout (also red), so it is pre-existing and unrelated
to that diff.

Full local unit suite on the PR branch: 1785 passed, 1 failed — this one.

Not investigated further in that pass; the fix under review was a CI merge-gate
change and chasing an unrelated enforcer-logging assertion would have widened it.

Worth checking whether CI sees this too, or whether it is another host-environment
failure of the `test_ingest_batch_dirty` family (read-only `/config` on the macOS
host, green in CI's container). If it is host-only, the value here is a skip
marker or a container guard so the local suite stops reporting a false red; if CI
is genuinely red, the enforcer's missing-log path regressed.
title: test_enforcer_missing_log_logs_single_info_not_warning_spam is red on main
